propositions: Project-declared code-review criteria are dropped at five seams: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission.
The project criterion extension contract must be documented and proven deployable through end-to-end tests spanning resolver, fan-in/attribution, routing, eval, and CLI layers.
Project criteria must execute once in Round A, retain logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id, and use repository-effective Pass-3 routing with correct threshold and blocking posture.
The eval/calibration API and CLI must admit active project code-review criteria while rejecting inactive or ambiguous ones, with a balanced corpus and prompt available.
No-overlay deployments must preserve the 13 built-in criteria, packaged Pass-3 dispositions, and default resolver mapping while supporting project overlays.
Live Gerrit dogfood must verify the repaired repository-root seam and cleaned prompt revision merge cleanly with LLM-Review approval and zero unresolved comments.
